description: The store's own similar-apps shelf for any app (Apple's You Might Also Like, Google's Similar apps), in shelf order, with each app's category, name and publisher and the day the shelf was read. The categories on the shelf show which crowd the store places the app in.

appId.description: App Store id (e.g. 570060128) or Google Play package name

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (empty = the newest shelf read in any storefront)

name: hive_similar_apps
